collisions.title: Clashes as short codes fill up
collisions.alt: The number of colliding short codes as a million URLs are hashed and cut to 4, 5, 6 or 8 characters. By a million URLs, four characters had about 29,000 clashes, five had 436, six had 8, and eight had none, which is drawn at the bottom of the scale.

timeline-pull.title: Reading a timeline by asking everyone you follow
timeline-pull.alt: Time to build a home timeline at read time, from a table of two million tweets, as the number of accounts followed grows from 10 to 5,000. The time grows with the number of accounts.

timeline-push.title: Writing one tweet into every follower's timeline
timeline-push.alt: Time to copy one tweet into every follower's timeline, as the follower count grows from 10 to a million. It grows in step with the followers, reaching seconds for a celebrity.

follows.title: The follows table
follows.hint: One row per follow, with an index for each direction. Try the Follow button's query, and see what a counter would save.
follows.query: SELECT count(*) AS followers FROM follows WHERE followee = 1;

presets.label: Am I following?
presets.sql:
EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, COSTS OFF, TIMING OFF, SUMMARY OFF)
SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM follows WHERE follower = 500 AND followee = 1);

presets.label: Who follows me? Page 1
presets.sql: SELECT follower FROM follows WHERE followee = 1 ORDER BY follower LIMIT 5;

presets.label: Follow twice
presets.sql:
INSERT INTO follows VALUES (500, 1) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;
SELECT count(*) FROM follows WHERE follower = 500;

shortener.title: Two short URL designs
shortener.hint: Generated ids are easy and guessable. Hash codes are unguessable and can collide. Try both.
shortener.setup:
CREATE TABLE urls (id bigserial PRIMARY KEY, long_url text NOT NULL);
CREATE TABLE codes (code char(8) PRIMARY KEY, long_url text NOT NULL);
shortener.query: INSERT INTO urls (long_url) VALUES ('https://example.com/my-page') RETURNING id;

presets.label: Hash it
presets.sql:
INSERT INTO codes VALUES (left(encode(sha256('https://example.com/my-page'::bytea), 'base64'), 8), 'https://example.com/my-page')
ON CONFLICT (code) DO NOTHING RETURNING code;
